body: Found a likely cross-boundary defect in preferences (`Facet::Matrix` on baseline ctx). Let me verify it and the responsive state decomposition.

## Prioritized findings

### High

1. **Dedup by `(check, selector)` collapses distinct findings** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/mod.rs:449-450`, `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/security.rs:145,171,319,494,507`
   `check_csp` emits one line per missing mandatory directive with the identical constant selector `meta[http-equiv=Content-Security-Policy]`; `check_sri` uses `script[src]`/`link[rel]` for every resource; `check_manifest` uses `link[rel=manifest]` for every bad link. The dispatcher keeps only the first pair, so a CSP with only `default-src` yields **1** line instead of 4, and 10 unhashed CDN scripts yield **1** SRI warning. The same key drops legitimate per-state `breakpoint-jump`/`fixed-viewport-height` lines from `responsive.rs:403-460,720-766`. Family-level unit tests call `run()` directly and therefore miss this.
   Fix: key dedup on `(check, selector, evidence.text)` (or make global selectors resource/directive-specific), preserving collapse only of byte-identical duplicates.

2. **Matrix-only path of `reduced-motion-guard-missing` is dead in `sniff check`** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/preferences.rs:292`, `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:118`, `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/mod.rs:431-444`
   `via_matrix` requires `ctx.has_facet(Facet::Matrix)`; `preferences::run` receives the context built from `baseline`, whose `matrix` was cleared. With the default 12-state capture (`__env` from state 0 = `no-preference`, no `__declared`), a page with `view-timeline-name`/infinite animation and no guard emits nothing. `preferences.rs:1251-1310` passes only because it bypasses the dispatcher.
   Fix: run this check with a ctx whose `doc.matrix` is `full.matrix` while nodes stay baseline (e.g. clone baseline and restore matrix before `preferences::run`).

3. **`baseline_document` silently no-ops when matrix tags lack node-ID ranges** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:110-113`
   `node_id_start`/`node_id_end` are `#[serde(default)]` (`sniff-core/src/modern.rs:317,320`), so older v2 or hand-built snapshots with matrix tags but no ranges return `doc.clone()`; rules, uniformity and every non-comparative modern check then repeat once per state — the exact duplication this change was meant to eliminate. Only the with-ranges case is tested (`check_cli.rs:166`).
   Fix: when ranges are absent, fall back to `roots[..len/matrix.len()]` positional slicing; never return the full document when `matrix.len() > 1`.

4. **Documented v2 `--json` payload is missing** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:212-237`, `crates/sniff-css/src/output.rs:170-172`
   Check lines and `__check_summary` are written only into the text buffer; `emit_success(json=true)` serializes `output.data` alone. `sniff check --json` therefore exposes no `data.checks` and no `data.__check_summary`, contradicting `docs/cli-surface.md:57-60` and `docs/modernization/02-arquitetura-alvo.md:130`. Batch mode inherits the same gap.
   Fix: build the lines/JSON objects once, add `checks` and `__check_summary` to `data` as well as to `buf`.

### Medium

5. **Empty matrix state resets ID rebasing and corrupts the baseline filter** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/capture.rs:258-260,283-296`, `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:114-116`
   `rebase_ids` returns `0` for an empty forest and `offset = last` discards the previous maximum. If state 1 captures no nodes, state 2 is rebased from `0` and its IDs collide with state 0; the first tag’s range `[1,last]` then retains both states in `baseline_document`. Tags still look complete, so `matrix_incomplete` (`check.rs:206`) stays silent.
   Fix: `offset = last.max(node_id_start).saturating_sub(1)` (or do not advance on empty states) and warn when a state has zero roots.

6. **Responsive state decomposition ignores the new node-ID ranges and assumes equal root counts** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/responsive.rs:139-149`
   `build_states` partitions roots by `roots.len()/observed`; it never uses `MatrixTag.node_id_start/end`. Unequal per-state forests (viewport/JS-dependent DOM) either skip **all** comparative checks or, when counts are merely divisible (e.g. 4+2 roots over 2 states), mispair nodes and emit false `breakpoint-jump`/overflow findings. `check.rs:206` only compares tag counts, so no envelope warning is produced for these cases.
   Fix: slice states by the captured ID ranges (falling back to positional slicing only when absent) and surface skipped comparisons as an envelope warning.

7. **`breakpoint-jump` flags emulation-only transitions** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/responsive.rs:403-460`
   The 12-state matrix is viewport-major; adjacent pairs `0→1`, `1→2`, `2→3` share a viewport and differ only in profile. `viewport_delta` is `(0,0)`, so any rect change >24px is reported as a breakpoint. The coarse profile also applies mobile device metrics (`sniff-engine/src/sniffer.rs:191`) without changing the tag viewport, guaranteeing spurious jumps/layout shifts.
   Fix: compare states with matching `tag.emulation` and differing `viewport`, not raw `states.windows(2)`.

8. **SRI origin check discards scheme and mis-normalizes protocol-relative URLs** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/security.rs:184-204,238-243`
   `url_authority` returns only `host[:port]`. `https://site` vs `http://site/a.js` compares equal (cross-origin/mixed-content false negative); `//site:443/a.js` skips default-port stripping because its scheme is `""`, so a same-origin resource is reported as cross-origin (false positive).
   Fix: return `(scheme, authority)`; resolve `//…` against the document origin before stripping default ports.

9. **`autocomplete` values matched as a single token** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/security.rs:401-406`
   `actual.eq_ignore_ascii_case(value)` rejects valid token lists such as `section-login email-verification-token` and `section-a email`, producing a false negative for the nonce check and a false positive "no email field in the same form".
   Fix: `actual.split_whitespace().any(|t| t.eq_ignore_ascii_case(value))`.

10. **LNA check declares a facet it never reads** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/security.rs:61,341-370`
    `lna-insecure-context-delegation` requires `Facet::Env`, but `is_secure_context` lives on `DocumentFacet`; a snapshot with `__document.isSecureContext=false` and an iframe `allow=local-network` but no `__env` line is silently skipped. Evidence source is also mislabeled `__env.isSecureContext`.
    Fix: remove `Facet::Env` from `required` and relabel the evidence source as `__document.isSecureContext + attrs.allow`.

11. **`--uniform` drops bug rules despite the documented compatibility no-op** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:133`, `docs/diff-checks.md:75`
    `sniff check snap.jsonl --uniform` (the README's recommended form) now yields uniformity + modern but no `rules`; previously that flag only selected uniformity, but the new default runs all three and the docs describe it as a no-op.
    Fix: `let run_rules = args.rules || !args.modern;`

12. **`opportunities_by_class` has the wrong shape** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:222-224`
    Emits `{"opportunity": N}` while `docs/diff-checks.md:84,173` and `docs/cli-surface.md:59-60` specify observability classes `D/F/N/E`; consumers reading those keys get `null`.
    Fix: emit all four counters from each check’s observability metadata, or remove the placeholder and correct the docs.

13. **CSP `'none'` requirement accepts mixed source lists and later duplicate directives** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/security.rs:281-298`
    `object-src 'none'` / `base-uri 'none'` pass when `'none'` merely appears alongside `'self'`, although the browser ignores `'none'` with other sources. `csp_directives` also lets a later duplicate win while CSP enforces the first. Both yield false "policy is safe" results.
    Fix: require `'none'` to be the sole source token and keep the first directive occurrence.

14. **Quoted `"none"`/`"normal"` pseudo content is suppressed** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/structure.rs:600-602,637`
    The keyword test runs on `unquote(source)`. `getComputedStyle` preserves quotes (`content: "none"` → `"none"`), which renders the *literal text* "none" and should be reported; it is currently skipped as if it were the bare CSS keyword.
    Fix: test the raw trimmed value for bare `none`/`normal` before unquoting.

### Low

15. **Schema promotion discards valid v2 facets on a malformed schema marker** — `crates/sniff-css-diff/src/model.rs:280-283,303-315`
    A non-numeric/oversized `schema` leaves `raw_schema = 1`, so successfully parsed `__document`/`__env`/`__declared`/matrix are cleared with no error.
    Fix: promote only when the marker is explicitly `1` (or absent *and* no v2 facets were parsed).

16. **Baseline picks the first matrix tag in wire order, not by `index`** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:108`
    Responsive checks sort tags by `index` (`responsive.rs:128-136`); a reordered matrix makes node checks and comparative checks use different state orders.
    Fix: `doc.matrix.iter().min_by_key(|t| t.index)`.

17. **Contradictory flags can run zero or silently narrowed families** — `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:132-134`
    `--rules --modern` runs only rules; via `--params`/`--batch`, `{"modern":true,"no_modern":true}` produces no checks at all (only a zeroed summary). Declared CLI conflicts do not cover these paths.
    Fix: validate the merged flags in `compute` and use `run_modern = args.modern || (!args.rules && !args.no_modern)`.

18. **Two structure specs under-declare facets** — `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/structure.rs:81-84,102-105,814,962`
    `CARD_INTERACTIVE_NESTED` declares `&[]` but reads `ctx.attr("type")`; `WEB_INSTALL_MANIFEST` declares only `Document` but reads `rel`/`href` attributes on LINK nodes. On partial snapshots this turns hidden inputs into interactive findings and misses linked manifests.
    Fix: add `Facet::Attrs` to both specs.

No panics, unbounded recursion, or randomized iteration were found in the reviewed non-test code; deterministic `BTreeMap`/sorted iteration is used throughout. Read-only review — no files edited, no builds or tests run.
